sources.title: KCSE Regulations 2024 (Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education)
KCSE Grading System: 12-point scale and aggregate points for the best seven subjects
Kenya National Examinations Council (Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education) Rules, Legal Notice 176 of 2009
Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development: secondary school curriculum

verification.notes: Draft, not yet reviewed by a KNEC or KICD curriculum officer. Codes, papers and maxima follow the KNEC subject catalogue and published paper fronts. The 12-point subject bands and the best-7 aggregate table follow KNEC's published grading table. Open items: (1) only the sighted Option A route is modelled; Mathematics Alternative B (122) with General Science (237), Biology for the Blind (236) and Kenyan Sign Language (504) for hearing-impaired candidates are not modelled. (2) Paper maxima were cross-checked where a paper front was available (English 60/80/60, Agriculture 90/90/20, Biology and Chemistry 80 per theory paper); the remaining maxima follow the standard 100-per-paper or 80/80/40 shapes and must be confirmed against the current KNEC regulations before release. (3) The mean-points scale is derived from KNEC's aggregate-points table: grade k covers aggregates 7(k-1)+1 to 7k, so the mean-points band for grade k is (k-1, k]. (4) The KNEC regulations PDF was cited from the search index because the file did not download in this environment. (5) Band codes spell the sign (A_MINUS, B_PLUS) because the schema's code alphabet excludes + and a leading -; the printed grade is the band label.
